jobs.description:
**Help make ON the brand people follow.**

*Social Media & Community Manager*

Have a feel for a great hook, an eye for video, and ideas you want to try? Help shape ON’s social presence—from the first idea to the post going live to discovering what people respond to. Build your portfolio with your mornings free.

ON USA is bringing a fresh perspective to electric lifestyle vehicles through design, technology, and everyday experiences. We’re looking for a curious, hands-on storyteller who enjoys making video, talking to people, and trying ideas.

**Start with the story before the launch**

Your first chapter: help turn an empty showroom into a story people want to follow. Capture the build, create time- lapses, meet the team, tease what’s coming, and build anticipation. When the vehicles arrive, you’ll capture first drives, real reactions, customer stories, and ON out around the city.

**What you’ll get to do**

 Create hooks, headlines, captions, and content ideas that make people stop scrolling and want to know more.

 Film short videos, behind-the-scenes moments, showroom progress, and real customer reactions.

 Plan content with Alex, our Creative Director, and brief our Creative Team on the assets and channel versions you need.

 Organize the content calendar, prepare and schedule approved posts, check that they go live, and engage in comments and messages.

 Monitor results—views, watch time, engagement, and inquiries. Share what you learn and propose new hooks and follow-ups to promising posts.

**Your ideas backed by creative talent and technology**

You’ll work with cameras, Insta360 equipment, iPhone gimbals, and a MacBook Pro. Our Creative Team will help turn your briefs and footage into polished assets, so you can focus on ideas, storytelling, and keeping the channels moving.

Our technology team is building state-of-the-art AI and automation tools to help develop ideas, adapt content, organize publishing, and monitor results. You’ll help put those tools to work and shape what they do next—with training and support, and no coding required.

**You don’t need a long résumé**

Studying, starting your career, or looking for work that leaves your mornings open? We welcome applicants with personal videos, club projects, or simply a strong idea and the drive to learn. Your curiosity and follow-through matter more than a long résumé.

**Make something people want to follow.**

**What we’re looking for**

 You enjoy making short videos and can show us something you’ve made—or talk us through an idea.

 You’re familiar with social video, especially Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts, and want to learn more.

 You notice details, can write a clear caption, and have a feel for an opening that makes someone stop scrolling.

 You’re comfortable starting conversations and willing to practice interviewing people.

 You take initiative, keep a posting calendar organized, enjoy spotting patterns in results, and welcome feedback.

 You can reliably work on-site in Huntington Beach and attend local activities within an agreed schedule.

No degree, large following, or years of agency experience required. Bring a practical feel for social content, curiosity about what works, and the willingness to learn the rest with us.

**Keep your mornings open**

Work 1 p.m.–9 p.m., five days a week, with two days off. Weekend coverage can be every weekend or every other weekend, on a rotation we discuss and agree together. The specific weekend days and weekday days off will be planned in advance.

Keep your mornings open for classes, personal commitments, or your own projects while gaining hands-on experience with a growing brand.

Each shift includes a 30-minute unpaid, duty-free meal break, for 37.5 paid hours per week, plus paid rest breaks as required.

Base pay: $35,000–$45,000 per year, depending on relevant skills and experience. Full-time, nonexempt; overtime paid as required.

Location: ON USA Experience Store, Huntington Beach, California.

**Let’s see how you think**

Send a short introduction and, if you have them, one to three examples of videos, posts, or other content you’ve made.

Personal projects count. Tell us your idea, what you did, and what you learned. A résumé is welcome but not required.

We’ll start with a short video conversation. Shortlisted applicants will join a simple, paid on-site exercise: capture a few moments, suggest a hook, and explain how you’d post it and judge the response. We provide the equipment. No elaborate take-home assignment.

We plan to meet candidates in the Los Angeles/Orange County area the week of December 7.

Apply to: h.gonzales@designsuccess.com

Tell us your availability for 1 p.m.–9 p.m. shifts and whether you prefer every-weekend or alternate-weekend coverage.

ON USA welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and career stages. We assess relevant skills, potential, and ability to do the work.

Pay: $35,000.00 - $45,000.00 per year

**About the job**

Help some of the world's largest enterprises get real value from AI. You'll grow a book of Whatfix's enterprise customers by bringing them new use cases, new applications and our AI-first products.

**Why this role**

* **Expansion-focused:** you won't carry renewals, so your time goes into growing accounts.
* **Existing & New AI products to sell:** into customers who already trust Whatfix.
* **Direct access to leadership:** work closely with our Co-Founder and CEO and our Global Head of Sales.
* **Uncapped incentives:** your upside grows with your accounts.

**About Whatfix**

Whatfix is an AI platform that helps enterprises get full value from the software and AI tools they invest in. We call this userization: technology should adapt to the user, not the other way round.

Our proprietary AI engine, ScreenSense, understands what a user is trying to do in an application and why, and delivers guidance, knowledge and automation in the flow of work. It powers Digital Adoption, Product Analytics and Mirror (simulation-based training), and our AI-first products: Seek, an AI assistant that acts across applications, and Mirror 2.0 for Gen AI role simulation.

We serve **700+ enterprise customers**, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as UPS Supply Chain Solutions.

We have raised **~$270M**, most recently a $125M Series E led by Warburg Pincus with SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and have been named a Leader in Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) reports by Gartner, Forrester, IDC and Everest Group for 5+ years running. We have four main offices in the US (San Jose), India (Bangalore and Gurgaon) and the UK (London), plus smaller offices in Germany, Singapore and Australia.

**The role**

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will own a book of Whatfix's enterprise customers in your region and grow them.

Your quota comes entirely from expansion within those accounts: new business units, new applications and our newer AI products.

You will be based in our San Jose office and work closely with your customers in person, alongside our Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Marketing and our product teams.

Our sales leadership, including our Co-Founder and CEO and our Global Head of Sales, is hands-on with the team, so expect direct mentorship and a short path from idea to decision.

* Bring what you hear from customers back to Product and Marketing.

**What you'll bring**

* A track record of carrying and beating a quota in B2B SaaS, with real experience growing existing enterprise accounts through upsell and cross-sell.
* Experience in long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with enterprise buyers, not only short transactional deals.
* Discovery and value-selling skills: you ask good questions, listen to the answers, and tie what you sell to the customer's business outcomes.
* The habit of building your own pipeline, including finding new teams and use cases inside accounts you already manage.
* AI fluency: you use AI tools daily in your own selling, and you can hold a confident, honest conversation with a CIO about how their organization adopts AI.

* Coachability and curiosity. You seek feedback, act on it, and learn new products quickly.
* Comfort in a lean, fast-moving team where you will roll up your sleeves.

We hire for trajectory, not just pedigree. If you have moved from mid-market into enterprise, or from customer success or renewals into a commercial number, and you are on a steep learning curve, we want to hear from you.
